reason: The money is nothing for me and I like that it makes the salon look modern, but my stylists work in Odia and Hindi. An English-only app means they won't use it properly, and I can't afford to annoy staff after losing two good stylists last year.
objection: It is only in English. If my stylists find it hard, they will skip billing in it or quietly resent being watched, and then the live view and drawer checks are worthless.
would_change_my_mind: An Odia/Hindi version of the stylist screens and the WhatsApp bills, plus a free trial month at my main outlet so I can see the staff actually use it before I pay for both branches.
